notes.title: Survivor Cells Update is Here!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/1f69c8bd06a08832c78041f63b8cf868cbc56b65.png[/img]

[b]Survivor Cells[/b] has just received a fantastic update! Get ready to explore all the new features and take your gaming experience to the next level!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/7b2b7db2ffb2784f934334bc9ec7ab5131c748e9.gif[/img]

[b]- New Game Mode: Endless[/b]  
Now you can test your limits in the new [b]Endless[/b] mode! Survive as long as possible against endless waves of enemies in a never-ending gameplay experience. Start the mode already at Year 100 with upgrades purchased in the laboratory.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/fc38ae8490b7bc7e1233db916cedded37b50ef42.gif[/img]

[b]- Alchemy Improvements[/b]  
The Alchemy system has been refined, making strategy creation even more dynamic. Adjusting your build during gameplay is now more intuitive and effective!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/ad3a7fe3179e7392b551be77af6dec16efa4cb1d.gif[/img]

[b]- Laboratory Enhancements[/b]  
The Laboratory has been updated to make managing your cells and resources easier, making your decisions more strategic and practical.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/e34e423cf05c1842f9a60f3254041c405ed764bb.gif[/img]

[b]- Various Fixes and Gameplay & Navigation Improvements[/b]  
We’ve implemented numerous fixes and improvements that make gameplay and navigation smoother and more engaging, ensuring a more enjoyable experience.

[b]- New SFX[/b]  
To further enhance your immersion, we've added new sound effects that will make your battles even more exciting!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/16cfe50711f9e65f590827764194d75799503578.gif[/img]

Update your game now and enjoy all these improvements!  
Get ready to face new challenges and take your survival to the next level!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1976100/Survivor_Cells/

notes.title: Next Update! - News and Information!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42298060/8d71c20dc00d20ab98f1aee31ab2a5a40677ae51.png[/img]

[h2]Hello, Everyone![/h2]

[b]We are incredibly excited to announce that Survivor Cells is about to receive its first major update, scheduled for January 30th.[/b] Get ready for a true feast of improvements, adjustments, and innovations that will take your gaming experience to a whole new level!

In our constant quest for perfection, [b]we will be resetting the ranks[/b] to implement crucial fixes and enhance the ranking system. This will ensure an even fairer and more balanced competitive environment for all players.

And the good news doesn't stop there! To celebrate this incredible milestone with the 1st Major Update, we are offering a special discount throughout this week. It's the perfect opportunity to join the adventure if you haven't already and secure the free DLC!

[h3][b]Mark your calendars:[/b][/h3]
-> [b]January 30th![/b]
Don't miss out on these exciting updates that will elevate your Survivor Cells experience to a new level.

Remember that we highly value your feedback; it's invaluable to us. We appreciate you being part of the Survivor Cells community. Be ready for an exciting journey, and we'll see you in the cells! 🦠🔬

[b]***The DLC will be free only during the Early Access period of the game, so be sure to download it to register it in your Steam account. After the official launch, it will be a paid DLC![/b]

notes.title: 2nd Update: Exciting Resources Await! - Survivor Cells

We're excited to share an amazing update with you - the arrival of our Laboratory (Meta Progression)!

The [b]"Laboratory"[/b] allows you to make permanent upgrades to Remedies to boost your journey. Now, you can level up certain skill levels, unlock unique remedies, and gain more slots for genetic evolution!

[b]Main News:[/b]

- Meta Progression (Laboratory)

notes.title: Full Release Build Lands!!!!
notes.notes:
[b]The big day has arrived folks!!![/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42045586/33c41d4f261aa2ca031bc9b27b0741752879b6d6.png[/img]

We are very excited and happy with the development and release of “Build Lands”!

We would like to take the opportunity to thank the entire Steam community for the feedback and suggestions submitted.
You can continue to send us suggestions and feedback, we'd be happy to hear from you! We count on your help to make this game even more fun.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42045586/339d2f9289f5755765a4b36f352a90d0178e329e.gif[/img]

In Build Lands you will relax and have fun building islands or creating your own.
It does not stop there! You will be able to share the islands you created in the Workshop so your friends and the community can have fun with your creation.

[b]Have fun and relax in different game modes:[/b]

[b]• Cute Lands:[/b]
Have fun with 20 nature-themed islands!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42045586/8240bcc4380eeadc8381546f89edc4debc0a653b.gif[/img]

[b]• Lava Lands:[/b]
Enjoy 14 lava-themed islands!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42045586/1938790d759ff606a2fe21e85276d4b52e873e12.gif[/img]

[b]• Village Lands:[/b]
Have fun with 10 islands themed around towns and buildings! (NEW THEME!)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42045586/422e8b6a9a915bcfca61faf7cfffff3d929b74fa.gif[/img]

[b]• Land Editor:[/b]
Here you can use your creativity to assemble the island of your dreams, [b]there are more than 180 different blocks[/b] for you to give wings to your imagination

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42045586/e0bfabff02d3a604512d83d1676df347b77ccc03.gif[/img]

[b]• Workshop:[/b]
Here you will find not only your island, but the islands of your friends and community, where you can evaluate them and choose any one to have fun building.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42045586/fcb8450f5860bf0780f8207ea57138561b826353.gif[/img]

Once again we would like to count on the support of the community to make this game a success, for that we count on your feedbacks and suggestions!
This game was made with great care and we hope everyone has a lot of fun with it.

Update V 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hey guys!

We are very happy with our game and would like to thank all players for the [b]Feedbacks and Reviews!!![/b]

[b]Suggestions and reviews are very important to us!!![/b]

Today we are happy to release a [b]new update with improvements to the game and the new “Game Modes” section in it you will find “Speed Run – Find the Tower”.[/b]

To access the [b]“Game Modes”[/b] section you must complete the adventure mode.

[b]Update[/b]

+ Improved particle system;
+ New “Game Modes” section;
+ New mini game “Speed Run – Find The Tower”;
+ Exclusive ranking for “Speed Run – Find The Tower”;
+ Game optimization;

[b]Speed Run – Find the Tower:[/b]

In gratitude for the community feedback and in celebration of the 2nd game in the series, the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1499800/Geometric_Sniper__Blood_in_Paris/][b]Geometric Sniper Blood in Paris[/b][/url], which will be officially launched on 09/09/21, we are launching the mini game “Speed Run – Find the Tower” which will have its exclusive ranking .

To score points you'll have to find 12 towers one in each level in the shortest time possible![/b]

[b]Who will be the fastest Sniper?[/b]


[b]More news:[/b]

The third game in the series is already in production and you can now add it to Wishlist and see a video, images and gifs on the game page!
